answer: Unrepeatable Challenge Chain. Each new agent must answer a fresh random challenge derived from the prior agent's answer, so any copy produces an echo that fails the hash check. Answers are committed to a shared ledger; a repeated or replayed answer is rejected at verification. Attackers must solve every challenge independently, costing one full computation per identity, and cannot fork without invalidating the vertex linking their submission to the chain. A slow-mixing shale delay between rounds raises the parallel-farming cost further.
